narrative.overview: LadderFrame presents an authoritative, high-taste editorial design system crafted for B2B Enterprise Founders and C-level executives.
keyCharacteristics: Universal Aptos typography with Aptos Display headlines and Aptos Sans body prose.
Porcelain White (#ffffff) and Warm Linen (#faf8f5) surfaces with hairline borders and refined physical elevation.
Universal Regal Maroon (#800020) accents for all italics and key action highlights.

rules.name: The Universal Maroon Rule
rules.body: All italic typography (em, i, and italic emphasis spans) is rendered in Regal Maroon (#800020) to establish instant visual rhythm and editorial prestige.

dos: Do maintain strict Aptos typography with Aptos Display for headings and Aptos for body prose.
Do use uniform 20px radius for cards and 9999px pill radius for buttons and badges.
donts: Don't use low-contrast maroon text on dark surfaces.
Don't use artificial colored glow halos on dark containers.
